policies: Keep complete source ways, source node order and source XZ coordinates. Render only within the two new strips.
Accepted boundary continuations are masked against decoded delivered physical rail ribbons before emission; accepted IDs alone do not imply whole-way coverage.
Do not emit depot yard tracks as public-street overlays or drape them on roofs. Their original source ways remain in osm-public-v1.json.
Layer-2 bridge tracks are held until their actual final rendered and collision decks and bank joins qualify; OSM layer is never a height authority.
Matching visual/HCOL floors, coarse-tier support, budget checks and final-world/runtime verification remain required. Selection is not a delivery or passenger-service claim.
